# Sudonex
> Custom iGaming software development company (founded 2018) building licensed-grade casino, slot, sportsbook, live-casino and crypto platforms for regulated operators. GLI-19 / iTech Labs ready; MGA, UKGC, Curaçao and Ontario fluent.

Sudonex builds owned, certifiable iGaming technology — not rented white-label skins. Operators come to Sudonex for bespoke platforms, MVP-to-scale builds, and compliance-first engineering.
